other_conditions: Must be a regular student entering class 9th in a government, government‑aided or local‑body school
Must have at least 55 % marks in Class 7th (relaxable by 5 % for SC/ST students) to appear for the selection test
Must pass both MAT and SAT with a combined minimum of 40 % marks (32 % for SC/ST students)
Must have at least 55 % marks in Class 8th at the time of selection (5 % relaxation for SC/ST students)
Must maintain good conduct as certified by the Head of the Institution and continue as a regular, full‑time student
Cannot be absent without proper leave and may receive only one Central Government scholarship
Must open a bank account in SBI, any public sector bank, or any scheduled bank with core‑banking facilities
Scholarship is discontinued if there is a gap of one academic session or if the student leaves the course within one month of admission
For renewal, must obtain a minimum of 60 % marks in Class 10th (relaxable by 5 % for SC/ST students) and achieve clear promotion to the next class in the first attempt
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) awarded to eligible students from class IX to XII.
